context.passage:
*E-mail*
To:
gmccafferty@greyharbor.ca
From:
mtoskala@norston.ca
Date:
2 June
Subject:
News from Norston
Dear Mr. McCafferty,
Thank you for being a loyal customer for the past three years. As the premier
business-to-business provider of office supplies for North America, we at Norston are
constantly renewing our stock. Although our annual catalogue shipped out two months
ago, we wanted to alert you to some product updates that have occurred since then.
• Our Eikennen office chair is now priced at $149 instead of $179.
• The Votna desk now comes in mahogany and oak in addition to cedar.
• The Bygden filing cabinet is available in white and grey in addition to black.
• Our Glamnor videoconference camera now includes a built-in microphone.
We also want to announce the long-awaited launch of our new Web site:
www.norston.ca. There you can sign up for our weekly newsletter, which is full of
updates and great deals. The first 50 subscribers are eligible to win a new Tyrgo laser
printer worth $350!
Sincerely,
Mia Toskala
Norston
context.passage_translation:
*电子邮件*
收件人：gmccafferty@greyharbor.ca
发件人：mtoskala@norston.ca
日期：6 月 2 日
主题：来自 Norston 的消息
尊敬的 McCafferty 先生：
感谢您在过去三年里一直是我们的忠实客户。作为北美领先的企业对企业办公用品供应商，Norston 公司一直在不断更新库存。尽管我们的年度目录已于两个月前寄出，但我们想提醒您自那时以来发生的一些产品更新。
• 我们的 Eikennen 办公椅现价为 149 美元，原价 179 美元。
• Votna 书桌现在除了雪松木外，还提供桃花心木和橡木两种颜色。
• Bygden 文件柜除黑色外，现在还有白色和灰色可选。
• 我们的 Glamnor 视频会议摄像头现在内置了麦克风。
我们还想宣布备受期待的新网站上线：
www.norston.ca。您可以在那里注册我们的每周通讯，其中包含大量更新和优惠信息。前 50 名订阅者有机会赢取一台价值 350 美元的 Tyrgo 激光打印机！
诚挚地，
Mia Toskala
Norston
